items.title: Phase 4: fix runtime audio playback in Godot (loop_end, surfaces, pitch tracking)
items.description: Fix the in-game audio problems found while validating the F1-94 audio integration: (1) engine/surface loops sounded high-pitched/choppy because AudioStreamWAV loop_end was computed from compressed data bytes (QOA import) instead of stream frames; (2) surface beds were not audible because the controller duplicated surface detection instead of reading GEVP wheel.surface_type; (3) engine revs did not track the tachometer because bands played at native pitch without pitch tracking; (4) shift one-shots only fired for gear changes. Add per-band pitch_scale = rpm / native_rpm with measured ENGINE_BAND_NATIVE_RPM, PITCH clamp, and weight-gated telemetry stats.
items.rationale: Validating the runtime audio revealed Godot-side playback bugs that made the approved bank sound wrong in game (loop truncation, silent surfaces, desynced revs). These are runtime fixes, not content changes.

items.user_value: The F-94 now plays the approved v10_vehicle bank correctly in game: clean loops, audible surfaces, and revs that follow the tachometer.
acceptance_criteria: Loop playback uses the imported stream duration (get_length()*mix_rate) for loop_end; the smoke fails if loop_end truncates below 90% of the stream.
Surface detection reads GEVP wheel.surface_type (Road/Curb/Grass/Gravel/Dirt) with collider fallback.
Per-band pitch_scale = rpm / ENGINE_BAND_NATIVE_RPM clamped [0.5, 3.5]; idle/redline smoke asserts track the tachometer.
Weight-gated telemetry summary ignores muted bands for pitch/clamp stats.
